items.title: Inline rendering with document​.currentScript
items.excerpt: Inline rendering with document​.currentScript Lean Rada describes a neat trick that takes advantage of the document.currentScript property. You can use that to drop in a tiny inline <script> element that replaces itself when the page loads: The year is <script> document.currentScript.replaceWith( new Date().getFullYear())</script> If you define a shortcut function like this: $=(...n)=>document.currentScript.replaceWith(...n) You get a tiny template language: The year is <script>$(new Date().getFullYear())</script> Tags: javascript
items.why_it_matters: Neat JavaScript trick using document.currentScript for inline rendering. Mildly interesting, but of little practical use in Next.js and React apps.

items.title: web-edit 0.1a2
items.excerpt: Release: web-edit 0.1a2 web-edit (previously) is my tiny web app for browsing and editing files in a folder. I mainly built it for editing files on different machines via Tailscale. I added a "copy to clipboard" option for both text and image data. I needed this because I was running pelican prompts on a laptop from my phone (here's DeepSeek 4.1 Flash 1017) and I wanted an easy way to copy the resulting logs into a Gist. Tags: projects, pelican-riding-a-bicycle, deepseek
items.why_it_matters: Minor alpha release of a personal file-editing web app. It mentions DeepSeek 4.1 Flash only in passing, with little relevance to our delivery work.

items.title: OpenCode Security Breach: Distillation Attack Hit Console Users With Linked AI Providers. How to Find OpenCode on Developer Machines and Respond
items.excerpt: OpenCode reported a breach affecting Console users with linked AI providers. Here is what the vendor has said, and how to find OpenCode on your developer machines.
